'''September 2000 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in New World Manga, Livingston, NJ on 23 September 2000. [[Patrick Ziagos]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1272">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-26-livingston-nj-9-23-00d1272/ livingston-nj-9-23-00], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 26 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-26-livingston-nj-9-23-00d1272/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' New World Manga, Livingston, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrick Ziagos]]
